user.title: Dial Matrix
user.description: Creates the Dial Matrix routing matrix. Add your doorbells, cameras and notification targets afterwards via Configure.

init.title: Dial Matrix
init.description: Choose what to edit. Changes are applied when you pick Save.

data_description.id: Short unique identifier, used in entity ids (e.g. front).
data_description.mqtt_topic: Optional. A message on this topic rings the doorbell; the payload is used as Frigate event id to attach a snapshot.

data_description.id: Short unique identifier, used in entity ids (e.g. driveway).
data_description.frigate_camera: Optional. Camera name as Frigate reports it, if different from the ID.
data_description.labels: Object labels that get their own row in the matrix.

camera_zones.title: Zones for {camera}
camera_zones.description: Optional. For each label, a comma-separated list of Frigate zones. When set, a detection is only routed once the object has entered one of them. Leave empty to route every detection.

data_description.id: Short unique identifier, used in entity ids (e.g. alice_phone).
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_alice_iphone. Leave empty for TTS-only targets.
data_description.notify_data: Merged into every push as data: (e.g. url, clickAction, ttl, priority, push.sound).

data.mqtt: Listen to Frigate events over MQTT

data_description.image_url: Attached to pushes when a Frigate event id is known. $event_id is substituted. Empty disables the image.

error.duplicate_id: This ID is already in use.
error.notify_data_not_mapping: Extra push data must be a mapping (key: value).

deprecated_yaml.title: Dial Matrix YAML configuration was imported
deprecated_yaml.description: The `dialmatrix:` block in configuration.yaml has been imported into the Dial Matrix integration and is no longer read. Remove it from configuration.yaml and manage the matrix via Settings → Devices & services → Dial Matrix → Configure.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Triggers a doorbell ring and fires a dialmatrix_ring event with the list of enabled notification targets.

doorbell_id.name: Doorbell ID
doorbell_id.description: The identifier of the doorbell that was triggered.

event_id.name: Frigate event ID
event_id.description: Optional Frigate event id, used to attach a snapshot to push notifications.

detect.name: Detect
detect.description: Reports a Frigate object detection (person, car, …) on a camera and fires a dialmatrix_detect event with the list of enabled notification targets.

camera_id.name: Camera ID
camera_id.description: The identifier of the camera as configured under cameras.

label.name: Label
label.description: The detected object label, e.g. person or car.

event_id.name: Frigate event ID
event_id.description: Optional Frigate event id, used to attach a snapshot to push notifications.

sub_label.name: Sub label
sub_label.description: Optional Frigate sub label (recognised face, licence plate).

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Optional list of Frigate zones the object is in.
